prompt: Create a vertical six-panel product-only Dior bag moodboard with six distinct complete icons: Lady Dior, Saddle, Book Tote, Dior Toujours hobo, 30 Montaigne flap and a compact Dior Bow evening bag. Balance Cannage leather, Dior Oblique textile and one embroidered surface in black, latte, blue, red and blush. No people, repeat silhouettes, detail-only crops, text or malformed logos. If people are shown, they must be adult fashion models. Absolutely no typography anywhere in the image: do not write the brand name, initials, slogans, captions, labels or decorative letters. This is a bags-only board. Do not include dedicated shoe, jewellery or clothing product tiles.
